<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# All green blocks collected (0 remaining). Blue passage = 2117 pixels.
# Use ACTION7 to spawn more green blocks.

result = action(['ACTION7'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After ACTION7: {len(green_blocks)} green blocks")
for g in green_blocks:
    b = g['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center_r = (min_r + max_r) // 2
    center_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2
    print(f"  rows {min_r}-{max_r}, cols {min_c}-{max_c}, center=({center_r}, {center_c})")

# Player position
player_b = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
for p in player_b:
    b = p['boundary']
    min_c = min(x[1] for x in b)
    max_c = max(x[1] for x in b)
    print(f"Player: cols {min_c}-{max_c}")

# Collect all green blocks by moving to align and clicking
# Sort green blocks by column (left to right)
green_blocks_sorted = sorted(green_blocks, key=lambda g: min(p[1] for p in g['boundary']))

for g in green_blocks_sorted:
    b = g['boundary']
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
    center_r = (min_r + max_r) // 2
    
    # Player needs to be aligned with green block
    # Player moves 5 columns per LEFT/RIGHT
    # Current player cols: need to check
    player_b = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
    p_min_c = min(x[1] for x in player_b[0]['boundary'])
    p_max_c = max(x[1] for x in player_b[0]['boundary'])
    p_center = (p_min_c + p_max_c) // 2
    
    # Calculate how many LEFT/RIGHT moves needed
    # Player center needs to be close to green block center
    diff = center_c - p_center
    print(f"  Green at col {center_c}, player at col {p_center}, diff={diff}")
    
    if diff > 0:
        moves = ['RIGHT'] * (diff // 5 + (1 if diff % 5 else 0))
    elif diff < 0:
        moves = ['LEFT'] * ((-diff) // 5 + (1 if (-diff) % 5 else 0))
    else:
        moves = []
    
    if moves:
        action(moves)
    
    # Click on green block
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
    
    # Check if green block was removed
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"  After click: {len(green_blocks)} green blocks")
    
    if len(green_blocks) == 0:
        break

print(f"\nFinal: {len(green_blocks)} green blocks")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
